description: Source code for managing remote cluster storage in Mattermost, including CRUD operations, querying, and updating remote cluster data.

classes.name: sqlRemoteClusterStore
classes.description: Implementation of RemoteClusterStore interface for SQL database operations related to remote clusters.

methods.name: newSqlRemoteClusterStore
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new sqlRemoteClusterStore instance.

methods.name: remoteClusterFields
methods.description: Generates a list of database fields for remote cluster queries, with optional prefix.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a new RemoteCluster to the database, handling pluginID collisions.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing RemoteCluster's data in the database.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Marks a RemoteCluster as deleted and removes associated shared channel remotes.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a RemoteCluster by its RemoteId, optionally including deleted ones.

methods.name: GetByPluginID
methods.description: Retrieves a RemoteCluster by its PluginID.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of RemoteClusters based on various filters, with pagination.

methods.name: UpdateTopics
methods.description: Updates the Topics field of a RemoteCluster.

methods.name: SetLastPingAt
methods.description: Updates the LastPingAt timestamp for a RemoteCluster.

methods.name: UpdateLastGlobalUserSyncAt
methods.description: Updates the LastGlobalUserSyncAt timestamp for a RemoteCluster.
